title: Fix Android white-screen crash when tapping any icon or navigation item

requirements.text: Fix the Android-only regression where tapping any icon-based UI control (including the bottom navigation tabs and other icon buttons) causes the app to turn into a blank white screen and become non-interactive.

quotes: Bug total.aucune icone n fonctionne ecran blanc à chaque fois
Toutes les icones et j nest pas dordinateur donc que sur android

acceptanceCriteria: On Android, tapping each bottom navigation item (Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, Reports) switches pages without rendering a blank white screen.
On Android, tapping icon-based controls in the header (e.g., login/logout) does not crash the UI or render a blank white screen.

If a runtime error occurs during navigation or icon interaction, the user sees a recoverable in-app error state (not a blank white screen), and the app remains usable after recovery (e.g., returning to the previous screen or reloading the app shell).

No duplicate or nested React Query provider setup remains that could cause inconsistent context behavior during navigation (the app must use a single React Query provider instance for the whole React tree).

constraints: Frontend files listed as immutable must not be edited directly: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no multi-canister architecture changes.
nonGoals: Adding new product features unrelated to the Android white-screen/icon-tap regression.
Implementing or requiring desktop-specific behavior verification (user cannot test on desktop).
